lines.text: A man asks Jesus how to obtain eternal life, and Jesus tells him to keep the commandments.
The young man says he has kept them all, so Jesus tells him to sell his possessions and give to the poor.
Jesus promises him treasure in Jerusalem, but the young man goes away in sorrow because he has great wealth.
Jesus says it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle, and the disciples ask who can be saved.
Peter asks what they will get, and Jesus says the disciples will sit on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Judah.
